We have carbon NMR shifts. Need number of C=O groups. Carbonyl carbons appear around 190-220 ppm for ketones, 160-185 for esters, amides, acids. The given shifts: 139.25, 134.60, 129, 128.3, 49.4, 26.1, 11.4. No high shift >160. So likely no carbonyl. Could be aromatic carbons ~120-140, aliphatic ~10-50. So answer 0.

But verify maybe IR would show C=O. Could request IR. However carbon NMR suggests none. To be safe, maybe get IR.
